correctness.rationale: From RESULT.md blob f7332b7, equations x=1-exp(-ay), y=1-exp(-bx) and R²=ab are exact. Composite survival map is strictly concave with derivative R² at zero. Put h(u)=-log(1-u), F(u)=log(h(u)/u); the coefficient comparison (e^t-1)^2(1-t)<t² for 0<t<1 proves F strictly convex. Its increasing inverse g is strictly concave; F(x)+F(y)=2log R, so Jensen gives P<=s_R, strict chord gives P>s_(R²)/2. Monotonicity of numerator xh(x)/yh(y) establishes strict decrease in |log(a/b)|. The independent matrix inverse (I-M)^-1 gives (2+a+b)/(2(1-R²)) and AM–GM. At R=1, critical nondegenerate process goes extinct with infinite mean. Numerically independently checked R=2 asymmetry cases approach the lower bound; finite values are diagnostics only.
residual_risks: The monotonicity proof is restricted to Poisson, purely cross-type rates, strictly positive finite a,b, equal founder mixture; no finite-population susceptible depletion.
